notes: Site is behind a Cloudflare managed challenge for direct HTTP fetch (tier 1 blocked); accessed via Playwright/Chromium (tier 2), which passed the challenge cleanly - no Claude-in-Chrome needed. robots.txt (https://www.finnishdesignshop.com/robots.txt) has no Claude/Anthropic-specific disallow, only routine login/checkout/non-en-us-locale exclusions plus a sitemap pointer. Homepage/mega-menu nav (en-us) has no visible seasonal entries; discovery required the categories.xml.gz and landing-pages.xml.gz sitemaps (en-us locale) grepped for holiday/christmas/easter/halloween/valentine/diwali/thanksgiving/new-year/black-friday/advent/wreath/ornament/santa terms, then each candidate URL was opened and inspected for genuine PLP structure (facet sidebar, filters, product grid, non-round qty) vs marketing/discount framing. Found a genuine Christmas hub 'Holiday Season Shop' (own URL /en-us/holiday-season-shop, SEO title 'Nordic Christmas decor & design gifts') with real PLP children carrying specific non-round counts, plus one Decor sub-category 'Holiday decorations'. Found a genuine Easter PLP (/en-us/easter, 'Scandi Easter Decoration', 342 products - specific, non-capped count, real facet/filter sidebar). Checked and EXCLUDED as non-genuine/marketing: /en-us/holiday/holiday-table, /en-us/holiday/holiday-home-decor, /en-us/holiday/holiday-arrivals (an older duplicate URL branch, all showing 0 products - dropped per zero-qty convention); /en-us/holiday-season-shop/gift-guide and its price/audience sub-filters (Gift Guide, explicitly excluded marketing type, 0 own products); /en-us/gift-ideas/holiday-gifts (redirects to the generic /en-us/gift-ideas hub, 1471 products, not holiday-specific); /en-us/top-holiday-gifts ('Evergreen design gifts up to 30% off', 8404 products = essentially the whole catalog with a sitewide discount banner, not a curated seasonal set); /en-us/valentines-day ('DESIGN WORTH FALLING FOR - UP TO 30% OFF', product count literally '10000+ products' - a display cap exceeding the entire catalog, confirming this is a sitewide discount promo re-skinned for Valentine's, not a genuine Valentine's category - excluded per the Sale/Offers marketing rule); /en-us/black-friday and its sub-pages (/black-friday/furniture 404, /black-friday/lighting 2679 products, /black-friday/sofas 512 products - each is essentially the full existing category re-badged with a Black Friday discount, matching the explicitly-excluded 'Black Friday Sale' example); all /en-us/design-edits/* seasonal-titled pages (halloween, halloween-boo-basket, valentines-day, inspiration-for-easter, christmas-table-setting, christmas-cooking, holiday-colors, holiday-gift-tips-*) are Design Edits/editorial inspiration pages, not PLPs. No dedicated Halloween, Diwali, Thanksgiving, New Year, or other festival PLP exists anywhere in the en-us categories/landing-pages sitemaps (search-term grep came back empty for those slugs) - absence recorded after inspecting both sitemaps and the relevant candidate URLs, not from site search alone. Category label 'Christmas' is used (rather than the site's own 'Holiday' label) because every child page's own SEO title explicitly frames it as Christmas ('Nordic Christmas decor', 'Nordic Christmas candles', 'Nordic Christmas dinnerware', 'Nordic Christmas kitchenware', 'Nordic Christmas textiles', 'Best Scandi design Christmas gift ideas'); sub_category wording is kept faithful to the site's own on-page/nav labels. All seasonal PLPs found legitimately overlap in product type with other decor categories (tableware, textiles, candles, kitchenware) per the Seasonal coexistence rule (rules.md sec 7) - not reassigned or excluded for that reason.
